title: Felix and the Uniform
author: Emrys Oyelaran
blurb: Casper Nakamura, a widowed lighthouse keeper during the year of the great storms, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. But when a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must finish the work while the workshop still stands before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
